items.line: It owns the pointer `See :process <pid> for details.`, added to every outcome message.
items.requirement: When a process finishes, the message that GUIProcess emits about the outcome must reference the PID of the finished process, with structure "{self.outcome} See :process {self.pid} for details."

items.line: **Given** a `testprocess` started with `--verbose`, running with PID 1234, **When** it exits with code 0, **Then** qutebrowser shows the info `Testprocess exited successfully. See :process 1234 for details.`
items.requirement: When the verbose flag is enabled and the process exits successfully, emit an info-level message "{self.outcome} See :process {self.pid} for details."; outcome text `{What} exited successfully.`

items.line: qutebrowser shows the error `Testprocess exited with status 1. See :process 1234 for details.`, **And** that text is the last entry of the log for this exit.
items.requirement: When a process fails (non-zero exit), report via error-level message with same structure and PID; outcome `{What} exited with status {code}.`

items.line: qutebrowser shows the error `Testprocess crashed with status 11 (SIGSEGV). See :process 1234 for details.`
items.requirement: When a process is terminated by a signal, report the signal in the outcome formatted "{What} {state} with status {code} ({signal_name})."

items.line: its text is `Testprocess terminated with status 15 (SIGTERM).`, its state is `terminated`, **And** it does not count as successful.
items.requirement: state_str() returns terminated for SIGTERM and crashed for other signals; SIGTERM is not successful (was_successful() false), outcome text stays terminated-with-signal form

items.line: its last message is the info `Testprocess terminated with status 15 (SIGTERM). See :process 1234 for details.`, **And** no error is shown.
items.requirement: SIGTERM treated like successful exit only for GUI messaging: no error-level message unless --verbose; with --verbose info-level message with PID suffix, as final message; without --verbose no message of any level

items.line: qutebrowser shows the info `Testprocess exited successfully. See :process 1234 for details.`
items.requirement: Verbose successful exit info message example: Testprocess with PID 1234 produces "Testprocess exited successfully. See :process 1234 for details."

items.line: qutebrowser shows the error `Testprocess exited with status 1. See :process 1234 for details.`, **And** that text is the last entry of the log for this exit.
items.requirement: Failed exit error example with PID 1234, and same text as the final entry in the process log

items.line: its text is `Testprocess terminated with status 15 (SIGTERM).`, its state is `terminated`
items.requirement: Signal outcome examples: SIGSEGV yields "Testprocess crashed with status 11 (SIGSEGV)." and SIGTERM yields "Testprocess terminated with status 15 (SIGTERM)."
The outcome's state_str() must return terminated for SIGTERM and crashed for other terminating signals.

items.line: **Given** a `testprocess` started without `--verbose`, running with PID 1234, **When** it is killed by SIGTERM, **Then** qutebrowser shows no message of any level about its exit.
items.requirement: SIGTERM treated like successful exit for messaging: no error unless --verbose; with --verbose emits info with PID, final message; example with PID 1234 and --verbose; without --verbose no message of any level
